summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Founding Members CRM Phase 1 (Mission Control). Backend: 35/35 pytest cases PASS (test_iter127_founding_members_crm.py) — covering the new /api/cms/crm/founding-members list (with status filter, free-text search across first_name/last_name/email/state_country/suburb/state/heard_from/admin_notes/tags, legacy 'new' -> 'registered' backfill, is_test exclusion, auth guard), stats endpoint (total/new_today/awaiting_contact including legacy new/invited/joined/opted_out/latest with name/email/state_country/created_at/id), PATCH with status validation + admin_notes + tags + history[] append + 404 on unknown id + 400 on empty body, curated showcase regression (/api/cms/founding-members list/create/patch/reorder/delete all still work), POST /api/public/register-interest defaults status='registered' and bumps total + awaiting_contact live, preview-token security fix (POST /api/cms/email-previews/preview-token returns 64-hex opaque token, iframe access WITHOUT token = 401, WITH preview-token = 200 HTML, bad 64-hex = 401, legacy JWT via ?token= still 200 for back-compat), and George live tools (count_interest_registrations with status/since_days/state_country, list_interest_registrations limit=1, founding_members_summary — invoked directly via services.george.tools.execute_tool, all deterministic). Frontend (Next.js Mission Control at localhost:3000): logged in as hello@friendplace.com.au, verified — (a) Sidebar 'Founding Members' link now points to /admin/crm/founding-members (previously /admin/founders); (b) The Bridge shows a FoundingMembersCard with 3 stat tiles (Total 3, New today 3, Awaiting contact 3) + latest registration line 'Garry — NSW — 34m ago' + 'Open →' link; (c) /admin/crm/founding-members renders 4 dashboard cards (Total Founding Members, New Today, Awaiting Contact, Latest Registration), 5 filter tabs (All 3, Awaiting contact 3, Invited 0, Joined 0, Opted out 0) with live counts, search box, and a 3-row table showing name/email, location · referral, registered, status dropdown, tags column; (d) Inline status dropdown change from 'registered' → 'invited' persisted (dropdown value updated + toast/feedback visible); (e) Row expansion opens Admin notes textarea ('Auto-saves on blur', 0/5000 counter), Tags input ('Press Enter or comma to add. Up to 20 tags, 40 chars each.'), Companion chosen indicator, and quick-action buttons 'Email {name}', 'Mark as Invited', 'Mark as Joined'; (f) /admin/emails iframe src confirmed to carry a 64-hex opaque token (NOT a JWT — token len=64, hex-only, 0 dots) — the P1 JWT-in-iframe security issue from iter126 is FIXED. All 5 templates still listed (Welcome/Waitlist thanks/Invitation/Password reset/Support ack) with correct signer categories. Sending Health panel still renders correctly (still orange 'Needs Attention' — DMARC still missing, purely DNS not code). Overall: NO REGRESSIONS, NO CRITICAL BUGS. Ready to ship Phase 1.

issues: Interactive elements (row expand chevron, filter tabs, inline status <select>, Admin notes textarea, Tags input, Mark as Invited/Joined buttons, dashboard cards, sidebar links) have no data-testid attributes. Everything is still testable via text/CSS but adding testIDs would harden future E2E runs. Low priority — no functional impact.

action_items: [Nice-to-have] Add data-testid attributes to the CRM page (status-dropdown, filter-tab-{key}, dashboard-card-{key}, row-{id}, admin-notes-input, tags-input, mark-invited-btn, mark-joined-btn) and to the FoundingMembersCard on The Bridge — makes future regression tests less selector-fragile.
[Nice-to-have — carried over from iter126] Add DMARC TXT record for friendplace.com.au before public launch. Sending Health remains orange purely on this. Not a code issue.
[Nice-to-have — carried over from iter126] Suppress 'Blocked script execution' console noise from the sandboxed email-preview iframe (strip <script> tags server-side).
critical_code_review_comments: cms_module.py:_admin_from_query_or_header cleanly separates the preview-token (64-hex) path from the legacy JWT path — the hex regex is tight and the DB lookup is scoped to cms_preview_tokens.  Nice: opportunistic sweep of expired tokens on each mint keeps the collection tiny.
The 'registered' filter path correctly combines with the free-text 'q' search via $and to preserve both clauses (verified by test_free_text_search_on_tag hitting a legacy 'new' row via tag='seed').

PATCH endpoint appends every change to history[] with admin_id + at + status/notes_updated/tags — good audit trail. Consider adding a schema for history entries (e.g. Pydantic model) in Phase 2 when the audit view lands.

George tools count_interest_registrations / list_interest_registrations / founding_members_summary all filter is_test:{ $ne: true } by default and normalise legacy 'new' status to 'registered' in list output — consistent with the CRM endpoint's normalisation. No LLM-facing IP or internal metadata leakage.

Frontend /admin/crm/founding-members page.tsx: nice UX — optimistic status update + toast, auto-save on blur for notes, chip-based tag input, quick-action row expansion. Only feedback is missing testIDs.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (sidebar link, bridge card, dashboard cards, filter tabs, search, table rendering, inline status dropdown persist + toast, row expansion, admin notes/tags UI, mark as invited/joined buttons visible, emails iframe uses 64-hex token not JWT)

seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 rows in interest_registrations (is_test:false) with ids 'iter127-test-{uuid}' — cleaned up on teardown. Also created + auto-cleaned one live public /register-interest submission (email pattern iter127-pub-*@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter127_founding_members_crm.py — covers the Founding Members CRM (Phase 1) end-to-end including the preview-token security fix and George live tools. Uses direct services.george.tools.execute_tool calls rather than SSE for determinism. Frontend admin login: hello@friendplace.com.au / TestPass2026!. CRM page at /admin/crm/founding-members. Bridge at /admin/bridge shows FoundingMembersCard. Emails Studio at /admin/emails. Preview-token endpoint: POST /api/cms/email-previews/preview-token (needs admin JWT) → {token, expires_at, ttl_seconds} where token is 64 hex chars. Iframe hit: GET /api/cms/email-previews/{name}.html?token=<64hex> returns 200 HTML.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All Phase 1 CRM features, preview-token P1 security fix, and George live tools verified working. Legacy 'new' -> 'registered' backfill is correctly applied in list output, in stats.awaiting_contact, AND in the George count/list tools.
